title: Baked Courgette Crisps
blurb: Thin slices of courgette baked until crisp and golden, topped with Parmesan and black pepper.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and line two baking trays with parchment paper.
Slice the courgettes very thinly, about 2mm thick, using a sharp knife or mandoline.
Pat the courgette slices dry with kitchen paper, then toss them in a bowl with the olive oil until lightly coated.
Arrange the slices in a single layer on the baking trays, making sure they do not overlap.
Sprinkle the Parmesan and black pepper evenly over the courgette slices.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the edges turn golden and crisp, watching carefully to prevent burning.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a minute before serving.
